title: Study 2: Meropenem Subcutaneous Administration
summary: Main objective: Meropenem Cmax difference at Day 5 between arms
conditions: Bacterial infections requiring treatment with meropenem

interventions.name: Meropenem Steriscience 1000 mg polvere per soluzione iniettabile/per infusione

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Free, written and informed consent signed by the participant before any study-specific procedure. At least 18 years old on the day of inclusion. Male or female participant. Hospitalized in a medical ward (not ICU) authorized for enrolment in the study. Clinical indication for treatment with meropenem, according to the treating physician and local antimicrobial practice. Initial intravenous meropenem treatment started before randomization, with the patient considered eligible for randomized continuation of intravenous meropenem or switch to subcutaneous meropenem according to the study design. Creatinine clearance >50 mL/min at eligibility confirmation. For women of childbearing potential, negative pregnancy test before randomization according to institutional procedures.
Exclusion criteria:
1. Known hypersensitivity to meropenem, carbapenems, other beta-lactam antibiotics, or any component of the formulation. Pregnant or breastfeeding women, or women intending to become pregnant during the study period. No ongoing clinical indication for meropenem treatment at the time of eligibility confirmation. Known microbiological resistance to meropenem when microbiological results are available before randomization and the investigator considers meropenem no longer appropriate. Creatinine clearance <=50 mL/min at eligibility confirmation. Admission to an intensive care unit; Initiation of invasive or non-invasive mechanical ventilation; Initiation of renal replacement therapy or dialysis; Initiation of vasopressor support with norepinephrine/noradrenaline or an equivalent vasopressor. Any clinical condition, physical examination finding, metabolic dysfunction, or laboratory abnormality that contraindicates meropenem treatment, may interfere with interpretation of study results, or may expose the participant to unacceptable risk according to the investigator. Inability to comply with study procedures or follow-up requirements.
